# Vendored third-party source

`rune/` is a source snapshot of Rune based on upstream revision
`cca5df6fafb4721d96fe105f126ebfd2ec351bb6`, including Veyra's local
GPU-frame bridge additions. It is kept as source rather than a submodule so a
fresh clone of Veyra builds without another checkout.

Rune's original [`LICENSE`](rune/LICENSE) is retained unchanged. Updates to
this directory must preserve that license and any license files shipped by its
vendored dependencies.
